question: In March 2023, Jan Aushadhi Train was flagged off by Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya and Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw at which of the following places?
solution:
The correct answer is **New Delhi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jan Aushadhi Train** was flagged off in March 2023.
 
• The event was attended by **Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya** and **Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw**.
 
• The flag-off ceremony took place at **New Delhi**.
 
• The initiative is part of the **Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)**
 A scheme to provide quality medicines at affordable prices to the masses through special stores known as **Jan Aushadhi Kendras**.
 
 

 **Objective**
 To make generic medicines available to everyone and reduce out-of-pocket expenses on healthcare.
 
 

 **Implementation**
 Implemented by the **Bureau of Pharma PSUs of India (BPPI)** under the aegis of the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers.
 
 

 **Benefits**
 Significant savings on healthcare costs for the common man.
